competitors.name: PORTA / Target
competitors.action: PORTA announced a nationwide Target and Target.com launch for four Roman-style frozen pizzas at a $11.99 SRP, bringing the brand's North American footprint to 4,500 retail doors. The company said the Target placement follows category-leading velocity and evidence that PORTA brings new shoppers into frozen pizza.

competitors.name: Amazon / Whole Foods Market
competitors.action: Grocery Dive reported that combined Amazon and Whole Foods grocery market share rose 0.6 percentage points to 4% over the 12 months ended June 30, the largest gain among measured grocers. The gain was tied mainly to Amazon's same-day perishables expansion, with CEO Andy Jassy saying monthly active perishable customers are up 50% since the start of the year.

competitors.name: Publix
competitors.action: Grocery Dive reported Publix Q2 sales grew 1% to $15.7 billion while comparable-store sales fell 0.5%, marking a fourth consecutive quarter of slowing sales growth. Publix cited pharmacy reimbursement changes and economic conditions affecting consumer spending, even as it opened 16 stores and remodeled 56 during the first half of the fiscal year.

trends.topic: Premium frozen growth is colliding with value-sensitive grocery traffic
trends.magnitude: Three new signals: PORTA reached 4,500 doors via Target, Amazon/Whole Foods gained 0.6 share points through perishables convenience, and Publix comps turned negative in Q2
trends.context: Retailers are still rewarding high-velocity premium freezer products that add shoppers to the aisle, but broader grocery demand remains constrained. Real Dough's strongest lane is a clearly differentiated premium pizza that can prove velocity, incrementality and everyday convenience without relying only on premium claims.
